metadata.title: Durvalumab, carboplatin and paclitaxel therapy
metadata.indication: First-line dMMR/MSI-H endometrial carcinoma, recurrent or primary advanced, unsuitable for potentially curative surgery, radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy, and eligible for systemic therapy.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-mapped feasibility build; independent clinical and pharmacy review pending

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently where supported. Omitted domains remain unassessed. Phase-specific and multi-input rules require their stated context.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Plan initiated by a consultant medical oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: All dose modifications require consultant discussion. Independent clinical and oncology pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: First-line dMMR/MSI-H endometrial carcinoma, recurrent or primary advanced, unsuitable for potentially curative surgery, radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy, and eligible for systemic therapy.

treatment_phases.label: Combination · every 21 days
treatment_phases.duration_text: 4–6 cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity. The treating team confirms the last combination dose.

administration.notes: Over 60 minutes, using a low-protein-binding 0.2–0.22 micrometre inline filter and separate line.
Over 3 hours with non-PVC equipment and 0.22 micrometre filter. Premedicate according to the verified prescription.
Over 30 minutes. Dose using Calvert with verified kidney function. Source caps dosing GFR at 125 mL/min.

treatment_phases.label: Maintenance · durvalumab alone every 28 days
treatment_phases.duration_text: Start 3 weeks after final combination cycle, then every 28 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

administration.notes: Over 60 minutes. At maintenance weight ≤30 kg, use 20 mg/kg until weight is >30 kg. No paclitaxel or carboplatin in this phase.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00953 p10: carboplatin high, paclitaxel low and durvalumab minimal; select the prescribed phase.

treatment.schedule_summary: Day 1 every 21 days: all three medicines for 4–6 cycles. If continuing, durvalumab alone starts 3 weeks after the last combination infusion, then repeats every 28 days while helping and tolerated.

eligibility.summary: First-line dMMR/MSI-H endometrial carcinoma, recurrent or primary advanced, unsuitable for potentially curative surgery, radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy, and eligible for systemic therapy. ECOG 0–1; ECOG 2 by consultant discretion. Adequate marrow, renal and hepatic function.

exclusions.summary: Pregnancy, breastfeeding, relevant drug/excipient hypersensitivity and severe hepatic impairment (paclitaxel). Review immunosuppression, transplant, autoimmunity, IBD, neuropathy and prior checkpoint exposure.

baseline: Validated dMMR/MSI-H result and clinical suitability; ECOG 0–1 (ECOG 2 only by consultant discretion).
FBC, renal and liver function, thyroid function and random glucose.
Isotope GFR preferred for carboplatin; estimate GFR/CrCl if needed. Neuropathy assessment and audiology when indicated.
regular: FBC, kidney and liver function, thyroid tests and random glucose. Cortisol and neuropathy assessment as clinically indicated.
If carboplatin dosing uses an estimated GFR/CrCl, calculate from serum creatinine taken within 48 hours. If isotope GFR used, review if creatinine rises above 110% of value at isotope measurement.
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Imaging and other tests follow the consultant’s treatment plan.
monitoring.viral_screening: Hepatitis B/C screening is not listed as universal in 00953; assess individual risk and local policy.

dose_modifications.summary: Durvalumab is withheld or discontinued according to the immune event. No toxicity dose reduction. Paclitaxel and carboplatin have separate induction-only rules. Consult NCCP pp5–10.
